card.title: Playstation 4 Unable to connect to charge/sync controller from USB ports repair

source.title: Playstation 4 Unable to connect to charge/sync controller from USB ports repair

symptoms: USB ports don't charge or sync controllers

claims.statement: PS4 USB ports dead: if 5 V is present at the ports, check 3.3 V on a specific cap; 0 V or about 2 V points to a regulator on the other side of the board, which commonly fails—gently heating it to see the voltage rise confirms it.

procedure: Measure 3.3 V at the indicated cap.
Warm the regulator to confirm; replace it.
card.caveats: Test point only shown in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
